title: Choice Privileges® Introduces Points Sharing, Making It Easier for Members to Travel Together

body_markdown:
*New feature enables members to transfer points with friends and family to unlock rewards faster*


Choice Hotels International, Inc. today announces the launch of a new points sharing feature within its award-winning Choice Privileges® loyalty program, giving members the ability to transfer points to friends and family to reach rewards faster.


The new feature, launching as part of the program’s broader[enhancements](https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-11-04-Choice-Privileges-Announces-an-All-New-Rewards-Experience-that-Offers-More-Rewards,-More-Often) this year, allows Choice Privileges members to share points seamlessly and for free, helping them combine rewards for reward nights, travel experiences and more. The initiative reflects Choice Hotels’ continued focus on making rewards more flexible and accessible for value-minded members.


“Today’s travelers are increasingly looking for more meaningful ways to experience the world together,” said Geeta Chandan, Vice President, Loyalty, Choice Hotels International. “By introducing points sharing as part of Choice Privileges, we’re making it even easier for our members to make memories together, whether they’re planning a family vacation, celebrating a milestone or simply helping a loved one get closer to their next getaway.”


Points sharing is part of Choice Privileges’ ongoing evolution, which includes new ways for members to earn and redeem rewards, reach Elite status faster, and enjoy more personalized benefits. As previously announced, these enhancements are designed to give members more value and flexibility throughout their travel journey.


Through the new feature, members can:


- Transfer points to friends and family to help fund reward stays
- Combine smaller balances into meaningful rewards faster
- Unlock more travel opportunities without waiting to earn points individually


The addition of points sharing complements other recent enhancements to the Choice Privileges program, including milestone rewards, faster paths to Elite status, and the introduction of a new top-tier Titanium status—all aimed at helping members get more out of every stay.


Choice Privileges continues to be recognized as an[award-winning hotel loyalty program](https://media.choicehotels.com/2026-06-15-Choice-Privileges-Tops-WalletHubs-List-as-the-1-Hotel-Rewards-Program-for-Second-Year-in-a-Row) by outlets such as[WalletHub](https://wallethub.com/edu/best-hotel-rewards-program/25939) , offering members a fast and easy way to earn rewards at thousands of hotels worldwide and redeem them for valuable perks, including reward nights, gift cards and travel experiences. With properties across 51 countries and territories, Choice Hotels offers accommodations for every budget and travel occasion through its diverse portfolio of brands, including Cambria Hotels, Comfort, Quality Inn and Everhome Suites. For more information about Choice Privileges, visit[www.choicehotels.com](https://www.choicehotels.com/) .
